sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-31 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-24') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) = 25
